Applies a saved light-theme preference before first paint, so a
       reload doesn't flash dark (the default) before the async /api/settings
       fetch in app.js's init() resolves and corrects it. Synchronous and
       blocking on purpose — must run before style.css is applied.

Below the responsive breakpoints (see style.css), #sidebar and
       #agent-panel become off-canvas drawers toggled by the buttons in
       #chat-topbar — this dims/covers the rest of the app while one is open
       and closes it on click, same role as the modal overlays below.

       from a pending scheduled item's edit button to modify it in place
Edit agent note modal, opened from the 🗒 button in the agent panel
Generic confirmation dialog, used for irreversible actions (delete chat/agent)

Full-size preview for a clicked attachment image. A new tab pointed
       straight at the data: URI (the previous approach) silently stays
       blank — Chrome blocks top-level navigation of a new tab to a data:
       URL. Rendering it in-page sidesteps that entirely.
